rare_diseases.description: Open Targets disease descriptions, xrefs, initial associated-target page and drug/clinical candidate metadata for MONDO IDs cross-linked from RareSource OMIM/Orphanet identifiers. The target_associations dataset separately contains reconciled aggregate association rows.

target_associations.description: All Open Targets aggregate target-disease associations for returned RareSource-mapped MONDO diseases. Tie-unstable offset pages were replaced for audited discrepancies using a single full page (<=3,000) or disjoint target-ID prefix partitions; score/source components are retained.

drug_candidates.description: Open Targets clinical candidate drug records from disease GraphQL pages. The corresponding disease-level provider candidate count matched returned row counts for this harvest.

grin_gene_disease_evidence.description: All cursor-paginated Open Targets source-native evidence records for MONDO diseases asserted/linked to GRIN2A or GRIN2B by ClinGen, GenCC, HPO or Orphadata. Evidence model scalar fields and nested first-level scalar fields were selected from the current GraphQL schema.

provider_release: Current Open Targets GraphQL API; release identifier not exposed in response (captured 2026-10-03). FTP index had 26.09 listed current, but this API response is not asserted to be pinned to that release.

coverage.limitation: All aggregate association pages are acquired for returned disease IDs only. The 1,342 MONDO IDs in the input crosswalk that did not resolve remain unknown for Open Targets; full source-native evidence is separately complete only for the focused GRIN2A/GRIN2B disease identifiers.

initial_offset_page_audit.method: distinct (disease_id,target.id) and per-disease distinct target counts over the original concatenated 100-row offset pages; exact raw artifacts retained
initial_offset_page_audit.query_tie_behavior: overlap occurs across adjacent pages at tied association scores, with identical score and source component payloads

original_offset_page_overlap_audit.method: distinct (disease_id,target.id) and per-disease distinct target counts over the original concatenated 100-row offset pages; exact raw artifacts retained
original_offset_page_overlap_audit.query_tie_behavior: overlap occurs across adjacent pages at tied association scores, with identical score and source component payloads

rights: Open Targets Platform data; provider documentation describes CC BY 4.0; review current release terms

evidence_dataset.selection: All Evidence scalar fields plus nested objects' direct scalar fields; paged until provider cursor exhausted. This focused dataset is complete for the 13 disease IDs linked to GRIN2A/GRIN2B by listed curated sources.
